projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Go
description: Go modules github.com/51Degrees/51degrees-go/{common,device-detection,ip-intelligence,pipeline}/v4. onpremise.New(onpremise.WithConfigHash(dd.NewConfigHash(dd.Default)), onpremise.WithDataFile(path), onpremise.WithAutoUpdate(false)) gives an *onpremise.Engine whose Process(evidence) results need Free(). IP Intelligence uses ipi_onpremise.New or ipi_cloud. Requires CGO_ENABLED=1, a C11 compiler, and Go 1.19+. Install with go get github.com/51Degrees/51degrees-go/device-detection/v4
